overview: The armor trim templates trim tools too: template, tool and material in the smithing table, the same three slots armor goes in.
A trimmed tool shows an inlay in the colour of the material, the way a trimmed armor icon does. A trim makes what it is on last longer, and a gold one keeps piglins calm.

1.0.0: All eighteen trim patterns go on swords, pickaxes, axes, shovels, hoes and spears, in all eleven materials. Wooden and stone tools take none.
Elytra take every pattern too, shown on the icon and on the wings while worn.
Shields take every pattern as a crest on the face, shown on the icon and in the hand, raised or not.
Emerald and quartz tools take every pattern when those mods are installed.
A tool in the trim of its own metal takes the darker shade, the way armor does.
A trimmed piece, armor or tool, lasts a quarter longer than a plain one.
Piglins leave alone anyone wearing a gold trim, as they do anyone wearing gold.
The patterns lose "Armor" from their names, and the templates say they apply to tools, elytra and shields.
